sources.title: DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017-SiegeLadder-GGUF - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: These are the weights we run DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 with on one home PC. The model has 552B parameters in its MoE plus Engram. It runs on the Siege-Ladder fork of llama.cpp, which streams experts through VRAM → RAM → NVMe. The code, patches and measurements are in that repository. This project ...

sources.snippet: API15 evaluation of DeepSeek-V4.1-Flash-1017 on 820 videos and 4,920 requests, completed on November 5, 2026. 4,892 successful responses are scored; 28 terminal content-policy exclusions follow the benchmark protocol. 47 successful unparseable responses score zero, including 16 output-budget truncations.
